verdict.rationale: Visa officially announces an MCP Server for connecting to Visa Intelligent Commerce APIs. The Visa Acceptance Agent Toolkit documents MCP server use, and a probe confirms the @visaacceptance/mcp package resolves on npm with Visa-staff maintainers. However, the documented toolkit tools cover Pay by Link and Invoicing rather than the core Intelligent Commerce flows, and the package is pre-1.0 (0.0.96). Missing for 10: first-party setup docs and a tool list for the Intelligent Commerce MCP server itself (enrollment, purchase intent, credential retrieval), and independent hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Introducing our Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Visa Intelligent Commerce: Developers can now connect to Visa Intelligent Commerce APIs through the MCP Server
you can integrate it with the Vercel AI SDK or use it to access a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
the Visa Acceptance Agent Toolkit MCP server resolves on the public npm registry (npm view @visaacceptance/mcp → 0.0.96, Visa-staff maintainers)
